summary.intent: Upgrade CI and release workflows off the retired macos-14 runner image, track the work as an Entire trail with full details, and then settle on following latest runner images instead of pinning versions.
summary.outcome: Moved four macos-14 entries to macos-15 (PR #421, trail #159, CI green, merged), then started a follow-up branch ci/latest-runner-images that commits a change from macos-15 to macos-latest. That follow-up is committed locally but not yet pushed, PR'd, or verified.

repo: The four macOS runner pins are `runner: macos-N` matrix entries (macos-arm64 and macos-x64) in .github/workflows/callisto-ci.yml (artifact preflight) and callisto-release.yml (release artifact build).
The generated build matrix in crates/callisto-graph/src/matrix.rs and the 'Test Suite (macos-latest)' job already use macos-latest.
All other runners are already ubuntu-latest except ubuntu-24.04-arm, which has no -latest label.
Entire automatically opens a draft PR when a trail is created for a branch, so use `gh pr edit` instead of `gh pr create`.
The 'Entire Gates' check stays pending until the trail is approved in Entire; the agent should not run `entire trail approve`.
Release runs for #409 and #420 on main failed (one at 'Derive and hash intent' on a Linux job); the cause was not found. A new run on #421's merge commit was in progress.
Recent main commits show git signature status 'E' because GitHub web-merge keys are not in the local keyring, not because they are unsigned.
Commits in this repo are GPG-signed; the author's key is 0E16D2800539671F.
The GitHub SSH key is ~/.ssh/gabe_techworx_dev, set as IdentityFile for Host github.com in ~/.ssh/config.

code.finding: A runner line near here was inspected with od -c and compared against HEAD while checking the sed edit.
Artifact preflight matrix region containing the macos runner entries that were edited.
Release artifact build matrix region containing the macos runner entries that were edited.

workflow: The sandbox blocks GPG signing, the SSH agent, keychain, and network for entire/gh, so those commands need to run with the sandbox off.
`!` shell commands from the user arrived as plain text and did not run when prefixed by other text or containing placeholders; they work only as the whole prompt.
actionlint flagged `uses: $/.github/actions/...` in both workflows, and that text is already in HEAD, so it is pre-existing.
Writing a temp trail body file and then deleting it left a stray untracked file once; prefer inline --body or clean up immediately.
Trade-off discussed: pinning macos-15 protects releases from image changes but ages out; macos-latest avoids repeat churn but ties builds to the alias.

friction: `gh pr create` failed to mint the orin-dx-pr-bot token (OpenSSL 'unsupported' on the private key); only `gh pr edit` worked.
GPG signing was blocked by the sandbox on the first commit attempt and needed a retry outside it.
The GitHub changelog page fetch returned nothing, so the macos-14 retirement date and macos-26 / macos-latest mapping stayed unconfirmed.
The first `entire trail create` with a $(cat file) body was followed by a second attempt with an inline body.
ssh-add could not be run or verified by the agent, and the user's `!` commands arrived as text, which cost several round trips.
Release runs for #409 and #420 failed for an undiagnosed reason.
